fields.name: cards
fields.label: Cards
fields.hint:
One card per line: an entity id, then optionally | a name, | icon=... and | type=...
A line starting with # starts a page (a tab), and // starts a note.

```
# Downstairs
light.kitchen
switch.fan | Fan
climate.living_room
cover.blinds | Blinds
media_player.tv
scene.movie_night | Movie night
# Outside
sensor.outside_temperature | Outside | icon=sun
lock.front_door
weather.home
```

Icons: bulb, power, plug, fan, thermostat, flame, blinds, tv, speaker, music, lock, sparkles, script, button, bell, gauge, droplet, bolt, battery, door, window, motion, shield, vacuum, sun, moon, cloud, rain, snow, wind, home, person, robot, toggle, heater, water. Types: toggle, light, fan, climate, cover, media, lock, action, sensor, vacuum, alarm, weather, number.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.hint: Shown at the top, and the name of the first page when the cards have pages.

fields.name: tabs
fields.label: Page tabs
fields.hint: Shown when the cards have pages (# lines). A swipe in from the left or right edge turns the page too.

fields.name: compact
fields.label: Compact cards
fields.hint: Smaller cards with no sliders or buttons: a tap on a card still switches it. More cards fit.

fields.name: showUpdated
fields.label: Show when it was updated
fields.hint: The time of the last update at the top, and how long ago each sensor changed.

options.label: Auto: high contrast where the panel shows no color

haRemote.name: Home Assistant remote
haRemote.description: A touch remote for Home Assistant: cards for lights, switches, climate, covers, media players, locks, scenes, scripts, sensors and more, on pages, from the scene's Cards setting.
